newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real drops 0.08 pct after mini-band lowered.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real drops 0.08 pct after mini-band lowered.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.08 percent to close at 1.0840 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market after the central bank lowered the real-dollar mini-band, dealers said.
The central bank reduced the mini-band Tuesday for the first time this month, lowering it 0.09 percent to between 1.0840 and 1.0890 reais per dollar through a buy/sell auction.
The previous mini-band was set July 31 at between 1.0830 and 1.0880 per greenback.
Commercial and financial forex contracts continued showing dollar inflows, dealers said. At 1630 local/1930 GMT, preliminary figures for forex contracts showed a $260 million surplus.
The central bank bought dollars at 1.0840 per dollar to drain excess dollars from the market in the late afternoon.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0897 per dollar, down 0.09 percent, following the lowering of the mini-band.
In the parallel market, the real rose 0.26 percent to end at 1.137 reais per dollar.
